When is the kitesurfing season on Koh Samui? | December to April is the main season, with the steadiest wind in February and March on the south-east coast. From May to November the wind is lighter and lessons move to Nathon on the west coast, best in the mornings; May and October are the weakest months.
Where can I kitesurf on Koh Samui? | The main spot is the shallow, reef-protected lagoon at Ban Harn and Hua Thanon on the south-east coast (December–April). Nathon on the west coast works from May to November, and Chaweng and Bophut are kited on windy days by experienced riders only.
How long does it take to learn to kitesurf? | Most beginners need 9–15 hours of lessons over 3–5 days to ride independently. A 3-day course usually covers IKO levels 1–2 and a 5-day course takes you to level 3, riding upwind on your own.
Can I rent kite gear on Koh Samui? | Yes, from the kite school on the south-east coast and shops around Chaweng, for riders who can already ride upwind and self-rescue. Expect to show your level or an IKO card; full-day rental has been about 4,000 THB.
Is Koh Samui good for beginner kitesurfers? | Yes, from December to April. The inner lagoon at Ban Harn and Hua Thanon is flat, sandy and waist-deep, one of the best places in Thailand to learn. Outside that season, wind is lighter and less reliable.
Is Koh Phangan better for kiting than Samui? | It has more schools and lagoons and stronger south-west wind from June to September, so it is better for a dedicated kite week. From December to April Samui's south-east lagoon is just as good for learning.
How much do kite lessons cost on Koh Samui? | A 2-hour discovery lesson costs about 3,500–4,000 THB in 2026. Packages with accommodation and an IKO licence on Samui cost 25,000 THB for 5 nights with 3 days of lessons and 32,500 THB for 7 nights with 5 days.
Can I wing foil or e-foil on Koh Samui? | Yes. Wing foiling needs less wind than kiting and is taught alongside kitesurfing in season, and e-foil boards, which need no wind, are offered on calm days at Nathon.
Is it safe to kitesurf at Chaweng beach? | Only for experienced riders on windy days. Chaweng has swimmers, boat traffic and chop, and from October to December onshore surf and rip currents; learners should use the lagoon on the south-east coast.
